title: feat(nm2ot3sly): O freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis same-lock y-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: Two-axis same-lock seed, y-probes, O freeze t+1 vs t+2: composition HOLD, reverse and face hold at both cuts. Its own N-gate concedes the result is 'only tautological because no children form at t+2' - the composition sub-band admitting its vacuity in one member.
